raw_segments.text: He walked on, where's my hat, by the way? Must have put it back on the peg, or hanging
up on the floor. Funny I don't remember that. Hal stand too full. Four umbrellas,
her rain cloak, picking up the letters, Drago's shop bell ringing. Queer I was just thinking
that moment. Brown, brillianteened hair over his collar. Just had a wash and brush up.
Wonder have I time for a bath this morning? Tyra Street.
Chap in the pay box there got away James Stevens, they say. O'Brien.
